content.name: Boy or Girl
content.description:
如今，许多男生在论坛上使用漂亮女生的照片作为头像。因此，很难一眼分辨出用户的性别。去年，我们的主人公在一个论坛认识了一位“美女”（他是这么认为的），进行了愉快的交流。后来，他们经常聊天，并最终在网上成为了情侣。

但就在昨天，他去见了这位“她”，却发现“她”实际上是一个非常强壮的男人！主人公很伤心，他已经无力再去爱了。于是，他想出了一个区分用户性别的方法。

他的方法是：如果用户名中不同字符的数量是奇数，那么判定该用户为男性；否则判定为女性。给你一个表示用户名的字符串，请帮助主人公按照他的方法判断该用户的性别。
content.formatI: 第一行包含一个非空字符串，仅由小写英文字母组成——表示用户名。该字符串最多包含 100 个字母。
content.formatO: 如果按照主人公的方法该用户为女性，则输出 “CHAT WITH HER!”（不含引号）；否则输出 “IGNORE HIM!”（不含引号）。
content.hint: 以第一个样例为例，用户名 "wjmzbmr" 有 6 个不同的字符，分别是：w、j、m、z、b、r。由于不同字符数为偶数，判定为女性，应输出 “CHAT WITH HER!”。

en.name: Boy or Girl
en.description:
Those days, many boys use beautiful girls' photos as avatars in forums. So it is pretty hard to tell the gender of a user at the first glance. Last year, our hero went to a forum and had a nice chat with a beauty (he thought so). After that they talked very often and eventually they became a couple in the network.

But yesterday, he came to see "her" in the real world and found out "she" is actually a very strong man! Our hero is very sad and he is too tired to love again now. So he came up with a way to recognize users' genders by their user names.

This is his method: if the number of distinct characters in one's user name is odd, then he is a male, otherwise she is a female. You are given the string that denotes the user name, please help our hero to determine the gender of this user by his method.
en.formatI: The first line contains a non-empty string, that contains only lowercase English letters — the user name. This string contains at most 100 letters.
en.formatO: If it is a female by our hero's method, print "CHAT WITH HER!" (without the quotes), otherwise, print "IGNORE HIM!" (without the quotes).
en.hint: For the first example. There are 6 distinct characters in "wjmzbmr". These characters are: "w", "j", "m", "z", "b", "r". So wjmzbmr is a female and you should print "CHAT WITH HER!".
